Bring the physical Memory Shard and evidence to Maerin. Mining 8, Smithing 8, Magic 8; recommended Combat 15.
Investigate the Wardkeeper ledger, abandoned tools and false summons at three Ironhollow homes.
Compare the missing families with the road, mine and shrine evidence. Speak to Maerin.
Recover the Wardkeepers’ service-hatch bearing. Mining 8.
Repair the bearing at Ironhollow’s ward workbench. Smithing 8.
Open only the outer service hatch with the repaired bearing and Magic 8. The prison seals remain intact.
Explore the occupied Underworks. Recover the agents’ field orders, then defeat the Oathbound Watcher beyond their barricades.
Reach Warden Edda. Learn what the unknown agents are attempting to awaken.
Restore the escape ventilation so Edda can evacuate the Wardkeeper survivors.
Race north to the final prison seal. Stop the masked operatives.
Return to Maerin with Edda’s testimony. The enemy has awakened Veyr.
Begin The Borrowed King with Maerin. Magic 10, Worship 8, any usable Spirit; recommended Combat 18.
Read the shard’s Wardkeeper record in your journal, then seek Master Alaric in Ironcrown’s library.
Bind 2 iron bars, 6 air relics and 6 mind relics at the ward workbench. Magic 10.
Return to Alaric. Learn the counter-ward’s signal and your Spirit’s tell.
Cross the Shattered Sanctum. Test three captive memories against your journal and Spirit reactions.
Meet Alaric before the inner arena. Confirm his identity and anchor the counter-ward.
Defeat Veyr through three phases. Watch physical warnings and use Spirit insight to expose his imitations.
Search the agents’ abandoned survey chart beside the shattered throne.
Return to Maerin. Collect the Veilbreaker Ring and record the other marked locations.
Veyr is defeated and Ironhollow is safe. Rook offers repeat echo hunts; the other targets remain unresolved.
